expires_today.title: Learn Unreal Engine 2026 Course Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
Harness the power of Unreal Engine with our latest Software Learning Bundle by Zenva. This expert-led collection contains specialized courses designed to help you build any genre of game: integrate strategy and base building into your next project with Build a Tower Defense Game in Unreal Engine, scare the pants off players with Make a Horror Game in Unreal Engine, or add a splash of retro fun with Develop a Classic Shoot 'em Up with Unreal Engine. Get serious about game design for a price you choose and help support Girls Who Code with your purchase!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before June 18th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Melodic Mayhem Vol. 2: A Comprehensive Audio and Music Bundle
expires_today.description: So much melodic mayhem we had to drop a Vol. 2!
expires_today.long_description:
Create the perfect audioscape for your next game or creative project with the Melodic Mayhem Vol. 2: A Comprehensive Audio and Music Bundle. Highlights from this extensive library of beta-ready assets include the Reece Coetzer Voice Over Pack, Ambient Music Pack Vol. 5, Fantasy UI Sound FX Pack, and more. Explore a variety of genres, from Heavy Metal guitars to soothing fantasy strings and everything in between. Get the assets you need to achieve the sound you’re looking for, and support a charity of your choice with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before June 18th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Awesome Automation
expires_today.long_description:
Sit back, relax, and let these games do all the work for you—well, almost all the work. You get to do the fun part! From fantasy stories to farming simulators, these games run on automation while you call the shots! Let your imagination run wild while you build machines to fight monsters in the engineering roguelike Rogue Voltage! Build the farm of your dreams, harvest delicious crops, raise adorable animals, and hire help to automate all the work in MR FARMBOY! Take care of colorful, adorable Morps and build your coziest bases in Time to Morp! There are even more ways to have fun with automation in this bundle, so grab it now at the price of your choice and support Farm Link with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before June 17th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Ultimate Environment & World Building Collection
expires_today.long_description:
Gorgeous and easy to implement scenery options have arrived within one curated bundle. Add unmatched realism and polish to your next development cycle with ready-to-use environmental assets designed to save you time and money! Fill your games with lost shrines, Asian terraces, medieval fantasy villages, modular Viking village kits, and so much more—all with FAB Professional License Keys! Get the environmental assets you need to help bring your next big fantasy or sci-fi game to life and help support the World Wildlife Fund with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Double Shift: Simulation Bundle
expires_today.long_description:

expires_today.title: Perplexing Puzzles
expires_today.long_description:
Flex your puzzle-solving skills and bend your brain into new shapes with this bundle of the best puzzle games! Challenge your sense of reality and jump inside the instant camera photos you take in Viewfinder! Solve logic puzzles to progress through a mysterious world full of secrets in Taiji! expires_today.title: The Best of Robert Silverberg by Open Road Media
expires_today.long_description: Feel like you’ve read all the new sci-fi and fantasy books and looking for something a little more classic? We’ve got a bundle full of the best novels and stories by celebrated author Robert Silverberg! Dive into his Majipoor Cycle with Lord Valentine’s Castle, following an amnesiac juggler who finds out he’s the heir to an entire planet, or start with the prequel trilogy launched by Sorcerers of Majipoor, and learn how the throne became so contested in the first place. Meet the new inheritors of the Earth in At Winter’s End, a tribe of humanoids who emerge from their hibernation after an apocalypse. Or keep things short and sweet with the novella Nightwings, set on an unfamiliar Earth facing alien invasion. There are many more worlds, futures, and adventures to explore in this ebook bundle of Silverberg’s work, so grab it now at the price of your choice and support the ALA’s Freedom to Read Foundation with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Kodansha Presents: BL, Yuri & More from Ichijinsha
expires_tomorrow.description: Get over $1200 worth of BL, Yuri & Other Hit Ichijinsha Manga in one bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

Looking to bolster your digital manga collection with BL, Yuri and more while also saving big in the process? Get more than 100 digital volumes and over $1200 worth of fan-favorite series like How to Deal When Your Intimidating Neighbor is Actually an Omega, I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day (Anime debuting this summer), and Wotakoi: Love is Hard for Otaku for only $30 with the Kodansha Presents: BL, Yuri & More from Ichijinsha bundle. A Humble-first, this bundle is the best way to experience Kodansha's Ichijinsha manga offerings while also supporting the Comic Book Legal Defense Fund—a non-profit organization dedicated to protecting the First Amendment rights of the comics art form and its community of retailers, creators, publishers, librarians, and readers.

expires_tomorrow.title: Critical Hits: ARPG Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Gather your weapons, rev your engines, and prepare for your greatest adventure yet with this bundle of action-adventure RPGs! There are so many more worlds to explore and quests to discover in this action-adventure bundle, so grab it now at the price of your choosing, and support the global efforts of Whale and Dolphin Conservation with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: The Ultimate ABLAZE Manga Collection
expires_within_72h.long_description: Manga library looking a little empty? We can fix that! We’ve teamed up with ABLAZE to bring you a huge bundle of the publisher’s most beloved manga, manhwa, and pinoy manga ebook series and collections, perfect for oldheads and new fans alike! Dive into the cutthroat world of professional chess (and pick up a few moves as you read) in Blitz! Discover the mystery of a hidden painting in JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure one-shot Rohan at the Louvre! Jump back in time to one of the O.G.s of science fiction manga (and one of director James Cameron’s favorite characters) in the Captain Harlock collection! That’s only a taste of what we have in store for you in this mega manga bonanza, so grab it now at the price of your choosing, and support Starlight Children’s Foundation with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: 12 for $10
expires_within_72h.description: Great games at a great discount
expires_within_72h.long_description:
What’s better than getting a bunch of fun, exciting video games you can play for hours? Getting them at a fantastic discount! Our latest 12 for $10 bundle is exactly what it says on the tin: 12 of our favorite games for just $10. Put your hand-eye coordination and fine motor skills to the test with the famously tricky (and famously fun) platformer Super Meat Boy! Enter the pixelated world of an ’80s cop show and solve the murders at the heart of Beat Cop! Hunt down anomalies and battle swarms of enemies in the cyberpunk action-adventure Anomaly Agent! There’s a lot more fun to be had in this bundle, so grab it now for just $10, and support buildOn with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: Lost Lands Adventure for 5th Edition by Frog God Games
expires_within_72h.description: Can you survive the Lost Lands?
expires_within_72h.long_description: Can you survive the Lost Lands? Gather your friends and roll the dice, because it’s time to journey into the Lost Lands! We’ve teamed up with Frog God Games for this massive TTRPG bundle chock-full of resources to plan your next campaign. Explore the winding streets of Bard’s Gate, a citadel of artisans and politicians whose people are menaced by dark forces within and without. Use the Tome of Artifacts to scatter magical weapons and relics throughout the land for your players to find. Find a starting point for your adventure with expanded description manuals like Rappan Athuk: Adventures in Zelkor’s Ferry. You can even score a physical copy of The World of the Lost Lands, the definitive guide to the entire setting, full of information on its locations, peoples, and historical data! Endless adventure awaits you in this bundle of nearly 80 TTRPG ebooks, so grab it now at the price of your choice and support Doctors Without Borders with your purchase!
